ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white regions occupy approximately 55% of the visible surface, primarily in the central lobes, contrasted against low-intensity black regions (45%) concentrated along the trailing edges and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields in the interior of both lobes; dense black mottling and stippling along the trailing edge boundaries; solid black pigment contiguous across the median notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel depth) across the majority of the trailing edge, with more pronounced jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the lower leading edges, transitioning to a tapering convex sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of light-colored pixels (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and scattered along the central black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) on the white field of the right lobe (image right) and finer vertical scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization at distal tips; multiple parallel linear rake marks across the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark 'V' or check-shaped pigmentation mark located in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white field.
